note: Held-out set (Week 8): 40 questions (20 EN, 20 AR) written after every threshold was fixed and never used to tune anything. None repeats a fact asked in evaluation_questions.json. Each expected_document_id was checked against the document text (the note gives the place), and each absent_fact question was checked against all 32 documents. 16 of the 40 are absent_fact, most of them close to a real topic (a fact the corpus does not state about something it does discuss). Same categories as evaluation_questions.json. The Arabic was AI-written and has not been reviewed by a native speaker.
